_meta.description: Registry of M7 scanners. Each scanner is code-derived (ast/regex over actual source), never trusts ledgers. Each produces a JSON state file consumed by a gate.

scanners.name: scan_production_authority
scanners.purpose: Determine what code ACTUALLY answers production requests and writes production semantic state. Detect 'new router -> old engine' false migrations. Counts PRODUCTION_M6_NATIVE_READ_TOOLS, OLD_V2_READ_AUTHORITY, UNSAFE_OR_SILENT_FALLBACK.

scanners.name: scan_tool_denominator
scanners.purpose: Enumerate production MCP semantic tools from server.py. Verify denominator stability: BOOTSTRAP_DENOMINATOR vs CURRENT. Detect disappearing tools.

scanners.name: scan_fact_kinds
scanners.purpose: Enumerate M6 fact kinds from m6_schema.py + m6_indexing.py emitters. Verify count and naming consistency.

scanners.name: scan_fallbacks
scanners.purpose: Enumerate normal fallback paths. Count NORMAL_OLD_V2_FALLBACKS, UNSAFE_OR_SILENT_FALLBACK in production default mode.

scanners.name: scan_normal_path_dependencies
scanners.purpose: Trace normal production read+write paths. Count NORMAL_OLD_V2_SEMANTIC_READS, NORMAL_OLD_V2_REQUIRED_WRITES, NORMAL_OLD_V2_FINALIZATION_DEPENDENCIES. Detects whether normal operation depends on whole-TU v2.

scanners.name: scan_economic_metrics
scanners.purpose: Measure economic metrics (frontend/materialization/storage/query latency). Reports all §39 metrics separately, never one combined 'reuse %'.
